value: Application + configuration + libraries + dependencies -> container -> isolated processes -> shared OS kernel
Container image -> image manifest + filesystem layers + configuration -> container runtime -> container lifecycle

fields.label: Core problem
fields.value: Package applications into isolated, portable environments while sharing operating-system resources and coordinating those environments at cluster scale.

fields.label: Mechanism chain
fields.value: Application dependencies/configuration -> container artifact/runtime -> isolated process environment -> shared kernel -> orchestration -> cluster management -> scaling/observability.

fields.label: Central insight
fields.value: Containerization is not merely packaging software. In the supplied source it is a layered system spanning virtualization boundaries, application packaging, standardized images/runtimes/distribution, orchestration and cluster operations, with a distinct shared-kernel security model.

record.name: Content address
record.description: A digest-derived identifier used to locate or identify content.
record.label: Content address

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Address and deduplicate objects based on content.

fields.label: Steps
value: Select a collision-resistant hash and a canonical byte representation.
Hash the content to derive a content address.
Store the object and index its address to physical storage.
On retrieval, recompute the hash to verify content integrity.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Collision handling and algorithm migration should be part of the design.
The content address is not automatically a claim of publisher authenticity.
